principles: Cut default token spend without weakening review coverage guarantees
Memory and playbook output stays advisory only (gateEvidence=false), never gate evidence
Full-scan capability is demoted, not deleted: always reachable via a recorded scanEscalationReason
Prompt-only stopgap: no runtime, gate, or DONE semantic changes
Every regression path is guarded by a static test that runs automatically
drivers: Token exhaustion across host accounts is the highest-priority operational problem (2026-07-09)
Execution boundary restricts edits to two prompt templates, their mirrors, and static tests
Scope-plan coverage checking must stay sound: decisions/ remains the objective truth source

options.name: prompt-stopgap-candidate-first
pros: Immediate token reduction on every scope-plan/behavior run
Smallest blast radius: prompt text + one new smoke test
Keeps full-scan escape hatch with an auditable escalation reason
Enumeration + keyword matching keeps coverage checking sound (candidateSpecSet never degenerates to relatedDocs-only)
cons: Prompt wording is advisory to the agent, not mechanically enforced at runtime
candidate selection quality depends on keyword heuristics; a poorly-named decision doc could be missed at triage

options.name: runtime-candidateSpecSet-service
pros: Mechanical enforcement: CLI computes and injects the candidate set, agents cannot ignore it
Could log scan metrics for later analysis
cons: Explicitly excluded by scope boundary (no runtime service, no metrics sink in this stopgap)
Days of work touching dispatch/prompt-registry runtime while accounts keep burning tokens
Higher regression risk across all reviewer lanes

options.name: shrink-decisions-corpus
pros: Attacks corpus size itself; benefits every consumer
cons: Requires mass doc archival decisions far outside this story scope
Does not fix the unconditional full-scan instruction; reviewers would still read whatever remains
Conflicts with decisions/ being append-mostly audit history

rationale: Only the prompt stopgap fits the frozen scope/execution boundary and lands token relief immediately; enumeration-plus-keyword-match keeps scope-plan coverage sound while the recorded scanEscalationReason path preserves full-scan capability for the five high-risk triggers. The runtime service and corpus-shrink options are explicitly out of scope for this story and slower to land.

preMortem.scenario: Reviewers ignore the new bounded-search instructions and full-scan anyway
preMortem.trigger: Prompt wording ambiguous or buried; agent defaults to old habits from training or cached prompts
preMortem.consequence: Token spend stays high despite the story landing
preMortem.mitigation: Put the search-budget rules at the top of the search-strategy section with imperative wording; static smoke asserts the required phrases exist in all six active copies; CHK-007 verifies rendered agent_prompt output

preMortem.scenario: Scope review quality drops and a spec commitment is missed
preMortem.trigger: candidateSpecSet triage misses a relevant decision doc whose filename and keywords do not match the story
preMortem.consequence: Checklist coverage gap ships; scope reviewer approves an under-scoped plan
preMortem.mitigation: Keep mandatory full-filename enumeration plus title triage of every decisions doc; candidate ambiguity is an explicit scanEscalationReason trigger, instructing escalation instead of guessing

preMortem.scenario: Prompt mirrors drift after the template edit
preMortem.trigger: Only the template is edited; .claude or .lattice-codex copy keeps the old full-scan wording
preMortem.consequence: Codex or Claude hosts keep burning tokens with the old instructions; guard smoke gives false confidence
preMortem.mitigation: CHK-005 syncs all copies and diffs them; the new smoke scans all six copies, not just templates

preMortem.trigger: lattice.config.json wiring blocked because the file is outside the execution boundary allowedPaths
preMortem.consequence: Regression protection exists but is dead code; old wording could return unnoticed
preMortem.mitigation: File scope_extension_proposal for the one-line wiring; if declined, bind explicit smoke execution as story verification evidence and surface the wiring gap to the user at DONE
